map.根据系统容量与当前/目标浓度，计算需补充的原液量或水量（支持直接补加与排液置换两: From system volume and current/target concentration, compute the concentrate or water to add (supports both direct top-up and drain-and-replace schemes).
map.💡 提高浓度：补原液 V×(c₂−c₁)/(cₛ−c₂)；降低浓度：补清水 V×: 💡 To raise concentration: add concentrate V×(c₂−c₁)/(cₛ−c₂); to lower it: add water V×(c₁−c₂)/c₂. The drain-and-replace scheme keeps volume constant.
map.浓度指冷却液中有效成分（乙二醇/防锈剂等）的体积百分比: Concentration is the volume percentage of active ingredient (ethylene glycol / rust inhibitor, etc.) in the coolant
map.补加后系统体积会增加，排液置换方案为先排出等量旧液再加入原液/水: Direct top-up increases system volume; the drain-and-replace scheme drains an equal amount of old fluid before adding concentrate/water
map.实际维护应同步检测 pH 值、冰点与防锈性能，避免单一指标调整: In practice also monitor pH, freezing point and rust inhibition, avoiding single-metric adjustments
map.📚 深度解析：冷却液浓度补加量计算（原液/清水）: 📚 Deep Dive: Coolant Top-up Calculation (Concentrate / Water)
map.浓度调整：系统容量与当前/目标浓度已知，算需补原液或清水量: Concentration adjustment: with system volume and current/target known, compute concentrate or water to add
map.排液置换：提高浓度时按补加量排液以保持总容量: Drain-and-replace: when raising concentration, drain by the top-up amount to keep total volume
map.防错：目标浓度不得高于原液浓度: Guard: target concentration must not exceed concentrate concentration
map.目标>当前：需补原液=容量×(目标−当前)÷(原液浓度−目标)，并排液等量保持体: Target > current: add concentrate = volume × (target − current) ÷ (concentrate conc. − target), and drain equal volume to keep capacity (e.g. 200 L system); target < current: add water = volume × (current − target) ÷ target, increasing total volume. Target must be < concentrate concentration.
map.系统 200 L、当前 5%、目标 8%、原液 100%：需补原液=200×(8: System 200 L, current 5%, target 8%, concentrate 100%: add concentrate = 200×(8−5)÷(100−8)=600÷92≈6.52 L; after draining 6.52 L total stays 200 L and concentration rises to 8%; to drop to 3% add water = 200×(5−3)÷3≈133.33 L.
map.只补原液不排液会使总容量增大、浓度被稀释达不到目标；按补加量排液（置换法）可在保: Adding concentrate alone grows total volume and dilutes it below target; draining by the top-up amount (replacement) raises concentration to target while keeping volume.
map.目标浓度能等于原液浓度吗？: Can the target equal the concentrate concentration?
map.不能，公式分母为「原液浓度−目标」，目标≥原液时分母≤0 无意义；原液即为上限，: No — the denominator is "concentrate − target"; if target ≥ concentrate the denominator ≤ 0 and the formula breaks. Concentrate is the ceiling; for higher concentration use a stronger concentrate.
map.冷却液浓度维护计算器根据系统容量、当前浓度与目标浓度，计算需要补充的原液量或清水: This coolant-concentration maintenance calculator computes the concentrate or water needed from system volume, current and target concentration, and offers a drain-and-replace scheme to keep volume constant; it suits cutting fluid, antifreeze and other coolant concentration management.
map.自动判断提高/降低浓度并给出方案: Auto-decides raise/lower and gives a scheme
